title: Tyla - Chanel STEP BY STEP Dance Tutorial (Explained) | Easy to Follow for Beginners

observation_window.sampling: provider default; not continuous motion capture

extraction.teacher_style: The teacher breaks down choreography into clear, step-by-step instructions with mirrored demonstrations. She provides verbal cues and counts while explaining body placement and alternative positioning for solo or group practice.

lesson_structure.note: Welcomes viewers and introduces the song and tutorial
Reminds viewers to mirror the video and adjust speed if needed
Breaks down the first move: freeze and body wave
Explains body roll technique step by step
Teaches the jump and hip movement section
Teaches the final turn and arm positioning
Recaps all steps learned so far with music/counts

steps_taught.name: Freeze and Body Wave
steps_taught.description: Freeze in place followed by a body wave down and up

steps_taught.name: Body Roll
steps_taught.description: Roll body starting from head through chest, stomach, and hips

steps_taught.name: Jump and Hip Bounce
steps_taught.description: Jump open into a squat and bounce hips with alternate heel lifts

steps_taught.name: Arm Wipe and Step
steps_taught.description: Step side to side while wiping arms up and down

what_works: Detailed breakdown of body isolation parts
what_hinders: Fast transitions between detailed breakdowns and full speed

quotes.text: This is just going to be quick and easy.
For this body wave, you can go whichever direction you want.
Our right hand, we're going to bite our nail.
Let's repeat from the freeze until this one.

evidence_segments.observation: Teacher demonstrates mirroring gesture by pointing to left and right sides on screen.
Teacher turns to the side profile to demonstrate body roll isolation.

extraction.distinctive_method: Explicitly labels left and right on screen corners and suggests speed adjustments in YouTube settings before starting.
